description: Claude plugin, MCP server, and agent skills for driving mindmap.io maps from an AI agent.

tool_signatures.name: autoExpandNode
tool_signatures.description: Generates follow-up prompts for the node's thread and creates them as `queued` child nodes, returning their ids — one child per prompt. How many prompts is the model's call, read from the node's own thread, so it varies by node; there is nothing to size or steer. A level holds a handful, and wider material comes back grouped, one prompt per group, so its members arrive a level further down. One level only: the children are created `queued` and are not run, and nothing recurses. Each child runs only when it is submitted; until then it reads back as `interrupted`. A node that already has children is refused with 409 `node_has_children`. Metered by the usage gate against the token's user; over budget returns 429. Ownership is enforced.

tool_signatures.name: getSubtree
tool_signatures.description: Returns a node and its descendants as a nested tree, so an agent can pull a branch without the whole map. Recurses without bound by default; the optional `depth` query parameter caps the descent (0 yields the node alone). Node IDs are unprefixed and ownership is enforced.

tool_signatures.name: submitNode
tool_signatures.description: Runs the LLM on a node and returns the completed node — the first generative operation. The call BLOCKS: it waits until no ancestor is still generating (the generation gate, so the response always sees complete ancestor context and never races a parent that is mid-stream), then runs the generation to completion server-side and returns the finished node. Metered by the usage gate against the token's user once the generation gate clears; over budget returns 429. Submitting a node that already has children is refused with 409 (regenerating it would invalidate the descendant conversation paths) unless it is an expand node and `force=true`, which deletes those children first via the structural cascade. Ownership is enforced.

tool_signatures.name: updateNode
tool_signatures.description: Applies a structural update to a node — text, note, model, node type (set/rotate), the collapsed flag, or its position among its siblings. A pure tree mutation: no LLM call, no metering. Ownership is enforced.

messages.description: Updated node content as the canonical messages array (UIMessage shape). It is the node's source of truth.

node_type.description: Set or rotate the node's type.

position.description: Move the node to this 0-based index among its siblings. Send the destination, not a step: the siblings between the old and new spot shift by one, and retrying the same request leaves the order as it is. The parent never changes. Must be less than the number of siblings; the root cannot move.

tool_signatures.name: uploadAttachment
tool_signatures.description:
Uploads one image or PDF into a map and returns the reference used to attach it. The request body is the file itself, not a multipart envelope: one file per request needs none, and it keeps per-file failure natural. Set `Content-Type` to the file's own media type and put its percent-encoded name in `X-Filename`.

Attach the result by appending a `file` part to the node's user message (`{ "type": "file", "mediaType": ..., "filename": ..., "url": ... }`) via create or update node. Images are described by the house model at upload and the description is what a model without vision reads in their place, so nothing extra is needed to make an attachment usable as context.

Accepts image/png, image/jpeg, image/webp, image/gif and application/pdf, up to 10 MB each and 5 per node. Ownership is enforced.
